function tryGpuDraw(host, totalMs): void

Defined in: website/components/media/draw-text/gpu.ts:70

tryGpuDraw — attempts the WebGPU reveal for a just-triggered element. Called from startAnimation after the char spans mount; resolves silently — on any failure the CSS animation is the render path (the canvas/class are only applied once the atlas + sheet are live).

Parameters

host

DrawText

The draw-text element.

totalMs

number

Wall-clock span of the reveal (last delay + duration) — the overlay disarms itself after it, restoring DOM paint.

Returns

void
